responsibility: Declares graphviz_out, GCC’s utility class for writing GraphViz DOT text through a pretty_printer. It exposes formatted print/println operations, indentation control, access to the underlying pretty printer, and helpers for emitting HTML-like table row/cell tags in node labels, providing a reusable front-end for DOT formatting rather than graph construction or CFG dumping logic.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration header for the graphviz helper layer: it introduces the graphviz_out formatting class and its methods for DOT text generation. Unlike graphviz.cc, which implements those methods, this header is the reusable interface; unlike graph.cc, it is generic DOT-format support rather than CFG visualization.
